articles.title: Cancellation and Waiting Fee
articles.body_text:
On-demand Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement

All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.

Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
- Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
- The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)

Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
- The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

Advanced Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement

All cancellations made > 15 minutes before the scheduled trip time are not chargeable.
(eg: Scheduled trip: 6 PM, any cancellation made before 5:45 PM is not chargeable.
If the advanced trip request is accepted only after 5:45 PM, riders will have a 3 minute grace period)

Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
- Rider cancels after the cancellation window (< Scheduled - 15mins OR Matched) OR
- The driver cancels the trip after waiting for > 3 minutes for the Rider to arrive at the pick-up point (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)

Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
- The driver waits for > 3 minutes for the Rider to board and continues to complete the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip)

* For fares up to $18, a flat fee of $1.15 (exclusive of GST) & for fares exceeding $18, a flat fee of $1.35 (exclusive of GST) will be included in the base fare. Cashless transactions will incur a payment transaction fee of 1.96%+ $0.24 (inclusive of GST) will apply for cashless transactions.

articles.body_text:

Nonetheless, do reach out to us if you feel you have been charged unfairly or wrongly, and we'll be happy to assist you.

articles.title: Understanding the Fare Structure
articles.body_text:
1. Trip Fare

This is the core charge based on the trip's distance and duration, ensuring that the cost aligns with the ride you take.

2. Service Fee & Platform Fee

Supports day-to-day platform operations and fuels ongoing innovation to improve both the driver and passenger experience.

3. Other Fees & Taxes

This includes GST, transaction fees, and any applicable taxes or charges.

The rider's fare ultimately supports a wide range of services, from driver earnings to platform sustainability. After deducting all other applicable fees and charges, Ryde reinvests its retained share into enhancing product features, improving service reliability, bonuses & incentives, and supporting long-term growth initiatives.

articles.title: I made a mess in my driver's vehicle
articles.body_text:
Accidents can sometimes occur during a trip, leaving a mess that requires professional cleaning. While the vehicle is being cleaned, the driver is unable to continue taking trips.

In such cases, a cleaning fee may apply to cover the cleaning costs.

When you may be charged

If a mess during your trip requires professional cleaning, a cleaning fee may apply based on the severity of the incident. Fees vary by the type and severity of the mess, as shown below:

Type of mess | Applicable Cleaning Fee
Food, groceries, or drink spillage; Sand or food crumbs | Up to $40
Bodily fluids (e.g. defecation, urination, blood); Stains (e.g. mud, dirt, paint, cement, tar, oil) | Up to S$120
Vomit | Up to S$200

How is the cleaning fee determined?

Ryde reviews the submitted photos, trip details, and cleaning receipt to determine the appropriate amount, up to the applicable cap. For example, a verified vomit incident may result in a cleaning fee of up to S$200.

How do I pay the cleaning fee?

Our team will contact you to provide payment instructions once the contamination claim has been verified.

What happens if I do not pay the fee?

Your account may be temporarily placed on hold and you will not be able to book any new rides until the payment is cleared.

As set out in our Terms of Use, riders are responsible for professional cleaning fees where applicable

What if I did not cause the contamination?

If you believe a cleaning fee was incorrectly charged, please reach out to us via RydeHELP.

Seat belts are a mandatory requirement. Both you and your driver must wear them throughout the ride to ensure safety.

If the seat belt at your seat is damaged or if your driver isn't wearing one, let us know immediately. Your safety matters, and we're here to ensure every ride is safe and comfortable.

How to report a seat belt issue

- Open the Ryde app and go to RydeHELP.
- Select Report a Safety Issue.
- Fill in the details of the issue, including the vehicle's registration number and any other relevant information.
- Submit the form, and our team will investigate promptly.

Your vigilance helps us maintain a safe and reliable experience for all. If you need any more help, please contact our support team via RydeHELP.

articles.title: In-App Calling Feature
articles.body_text:
1. What is the in-app call feature?

It's a new way for riders and drivers to call each other directly through the Ryde app - no need to use your personal phone line.

In-app calls offer better privacy and convenience. Your number stays hidden, and you won't need to switch between the app and your phone dialer.

2. Do I need to allow any permissions?

Yes. You'll need to allow microphone access for the app to enable voice communication.

As long as you have notifications and microphone access enabled, you'll be alerted to an incoming in-app call.

3. What should I do if I can't hear the other person?

Try these steps:
- Check your volume settings
- Ensure your mic permission is enabled
- If the problem persists, hang up and call again or use chat

4. What to do if in-app call failed

If the in-app call doesn't go through, you can still use the in-app chat or contact the other party via SMS or a masked number.

In-app calls require a stable internet connection. If your connection is weak, the call quality may be affected or may not go through.

You can report issues through the app under RydeHelp > Contact Support. We'd love to hear your feedback!

5. Can I use regular phone calls?

In-app calling is the default option. However, if you have no internet, the system will automatically use a regular phone call.

2. The driver pressed "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

articles.title: My Rider Made a Mess
articles.body_text:
An unexpected mess shouldn't cost you your time on the road. When these incidents happen, Ryde is here to support you.

We understand that a mess costs you more than just a cleaning fee; it also takes you off the road. Ryde's reimbursement tiers are structured to reflect both the cleaning cost and the downtime.

What should I do when there is a mess

- Riders are responsible for the cleaning expenses if they create a mess in your vehicle
- Do not demand compensation directly from riders; submit a claim to Ryde for the cleaning expenses to be reimbursed to you.
- Inform the passenger that the incident will be reported to Ryde
- At least one photo must show the vehicle's car plate number to verify the vehicle

How to submit a claim:

1. Your vehicle must be professionally cleaned within 24 hours from the incident
2. Submit your claim via the driver app within 48 hours from the affected trip
3. Provide the following details in your claim:

*Proof of mess (i.e. photo of the vomit, stains, etc.)

*Receipt from the cleaning company with:

- Company's name, contact number, address
- Cleaning date
- Car plate number
- Authorised personnel's signature and company stamp

What kind of mess can I claim

Type of mess | Maximum Claim Amount
Spillage of food/ drinks/ groceries, food crumbs, sand | Up to $40
Human or pet bodily fluids (i.e., blood, urination, defecation) *Pet fur & saliva not claimable; Stains (e.g. mud, dirt, paint, cement, tar, oil) | Up to S$120
Vomit | Up to S$200

All claims are subject to review. Ryde reserves the sole discretion to approve, deny, and decide on a fair reimbursement amount.

Once you submit your claim, our team will review the photos, cleaning receipt, and may verify the incident details where required.

If your claim is approved, your reimbursement will be credited to you promptly after approval. The reimbursement is guaranteed and is not dependent on the rider completing payment, as Ryde will manage the recovery process separately.

You can appeal within 24 hours if you disagree with the outcome of your claim with any additional supporting evidence.

What if the cleaning cost exceeds the policy cap?

Reimbursement will be capped based on the applicable tier (up to S$200). Any excess amount will not be covered.

Important

*Mess that can be cleaned immediately without professional cleaning will not be reimbursed.

*Fur and saliva from pets are expected during pet-friendly trips and will not be reimbursed.

It is the trip fare after deducting platform and service fees*.

Riders see their total fare. Drivers see only their Net Fare (take-home).

No. Bonus calculation remains unchanged.

At Ryde, we want to create value sustainably for our users by providing simple, seamless and reliable transportation and logistic services at reasonable prices. The mission is to build a platform and ecosystem that makes every ride a better one.

We strive to continually upkeep the community to ensure that it is trustworthy, like-minded and respectable. In order to do so, our app will monitor the driver-partner's performance via the following metrics - driver ratings, cancellation rates, reviews and account activity, etc.

1. Conditions, where driver accounts will be temporarily disabled:

Driver Rating (DR) | < 4.80
Cancellation Rate (CR) | > 17.5%
Adverse Ratings | Drivers who receive poor ratings for errant behaviour. E.g. Comments on race, ethnicity, national origin, disability, etc.
Minimum Acceptance Rate (AR) | We do not have a minimum AR criteria
Fraudulent Activity | Drivers who overcharge riders and/or complete the trip without the rider onboard.
Dormant Account | Did not complete at least one trip within 1 Year.

2. Driver Ratings (DR)

The driver's rating is calculated based on his/her last 100 trips to ensure that it reflects the driver's recent performance. All new drivers will have a default rating of 4.90 and will be adjusted after the 11th unique review. Please allow up to 7 working days for the update to be reflected.

3. Cancellation Rate (CR)

The driver's cancellation rate will be calculated based on his/her most recent trips. The driver's cancellation rate will increase after a driver accepts a trip booking and cancels. We strongly advise drivers to only accept jobs that they can fulfill.

In the case of rider no-shows, drivers can still cancel the trip. Drivers do not have to worry about account suspension from trip cancellations. Our app algorithms will look at the driver's most recent trips. As long as the driver continues accepting trips, he/she will not be suspended from cancellations.

3A. Trip Acceptance and Cancellation Policy

Drivers are strictly prohibited from accepting a trip and subsequently canceling it without a valid reason after the rider has boarded the vehicle. Such behavior undermines trust and violates Ryde's community standards. Valid reasons do not include, but are not limited to:

1. Cancelling due to the rider's race, ethnicity, or national origin
2. Cancelling due to the rider's pet type or the presence of pets
3. Cancelling for any discriminatory or prejudiced reasons
4. Cancelling for personal preferences not related to safety or legal regulations

For bookings with specific requirements, drivers should accept only if they can fulfil them:
- RydePet: only if comfortable transporting pets. If not, or if you have allergies, do not accept
- Child/Booster seat: only if a suitable booster seat is available

Any such breaches will be subject to investigation and may result in account suspension or other penalties under Ryde's policies.

4. Fraudulent Activity

Drivers who are found to have overcharged riders or completed trips without the rider onboard may face account suspension. The Ryde Driver app is equipped with Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms that automatically detect and flag suspicious activity. Any incentives, bonuses, or rewards claimed through such misconduct will be forfeited. We take such matters seriously to ensure a fair and trustworthy platform for all users.

4A. In-Vehicle Recording Devices (IVRDs)

To maintain the privacy and safety of all users, in-vehicle recording devices (IVRDs) are not allowed on the Ryde platform.

If you currently have IVRDs installed in your vehicle, you are required to remove them immediately. Ryde takes privacy seriously, and the use of such devices may constitute a breach of local data protection regulations.

Should any reports be received regarding the use of IVRDs, your account may be suspended immediately, with or without prior notice. The matter may also be reported to the Land Transport Authority (LTA) for further investigation and possible enforcement action.

5. Reporting to Government Authorities

Ryde enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy against fraudulent activity to uphold the integrity of our platform and ensure compliance with government regulations. Any suspected fraudulent or misleading activity may result in immediate temporary suspension pending investigation, and if confirmed, may lead to account suspension, forfeiture, and/or reversal of payments, incentives, bonuses, vouchers, or rewards, as well as reporting to the relevant authorities.

Fraudulent behavior may take many forms. This includes, but is not limited to:

1. Overcharging riders or manipulating fares
2. Completing trips without the rider onboard
3. Misrepresenting trip or rider details to obtain incentives
4. Submitting false documents or declarations
5. Remaining stationary and uncontactable after accepting a ride to trigger cancellation or waiting fees
6. Using another person's account or allowing others to use your account
7. Attempting to bypass platform policies or system checks
8. Abuse of Cancellation and Waiting Fee Policy

Where Ryde reasonably suspects serious or repeated violations, it may report such conduct to government agencies such as the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), Land Transport Authority (LTA), Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS), and the Central Provident Fund Board (CPF Board). These agencies may take enforcement actions, including license revocation, financial penalties, or legal prosecution, which may result in possible imprisonment.

We expect all driver-partners to operate responsibly and lawfully. Ryde is committed to investigating all reports of misconduct fairly and impartially. Driver-partners will be given the opportunity to respond before final decisions are made, except in urgent or high-risk situations. Repeated or severe breaches may lead to permanent suspension from the Ryde platform.

6. Restoration of Disabled Driver Account

At Ryde, ensuring a positive experience for both drivers and riders is paramount, and maintaining community standards is essential. Accounts not meeting our standards, as identified by our computer algorithms, will be automatically placed on temporary hold.

However, we value your commitment and support to our platform and we are here to listen to your concerns. As such, If you believe that your account disability is not justified, we encourage you to appeal. Rest assured, your appeal will receive our prompt attention, and we will strive to resolve it within 3 days. We are here to assist you throughout this process.

Alternatively, if you prefer not to appeal, you can proceed to pay the processing fee of $10 [excluding GST] for the restoration of your account using the link to your registered email address with Ryde. Upon account reactivation, the driver ratings will be reset to 4.90 and CR reset to 0%.

7. The processing fee of $10 (excluding GST) is applied for the account restoration. This fee has been implemented to cover the operational costs associated with the account restoration, outlined below:

a. To cover efforts for re-verifying your profile and backend processing, including document review, to meet standards for resuming driving activities

b. To avoid any adverse effects stemming from a prior account suspension, the fee incorporates the resetting of your rating and review, offering a clean slate for your account.

c. To maintain a fair and secure environment for all users by enforcing necessary checks and balances during the account restoration process.

Repeated failure to abide by Ryde community standards will lead to permanent suspension from the Ryde platform. This is to ensure we uphold high standards and offer a good user experience for our community.

8. Dormant Accounts

All driver accounts must be active in the past 1 year and did not complete at least one trip in 1 year. This is to ensure that the drivers on Ryde remain current. We also aim to prevent compromised driver accounts and to eliminate fraud risks.

Drivers who are unable to log in after 1 year of inactivity must appeal by writing to support@rydesharing.com. Drivers will need to pay a processing fee of $10 [excluding GST] for reactivation. Driver ratings and cancellation rate will reset to 4.90 and 0% respectively. Please allow up to 48 hours for processing upon successful appeal.

*UPDATE*

Inactive driver processing fees may be waived until December 2025, subject to account eligibility and review. Simply write to support@rydesharing with your registered mobile number indicating a request for restoration. Our Customer Excellence team will process your request accordingly.

9. Closed Accounts

Driver accounts will be de-activated and their Wallet balance will be written off upon three years of inactivity from the date of the last completed trip.

Should you wish to drive on the Ryde platform again, you would then have to write in to support@rydesharing.com to obtain approval from the operations team to create a new driver account. Criteria for approval include but is not limited to, a track record of conduct that is in line with our driver community standards. Please allow up to 7 working days for approval.

articles.title: Ryde Code Of Conduct
articles.body_text:
Ryde upholds a firm policy regarding violations of the Code of Conduct, to which our independent driver and delivery partners are held accountable as members of the Ryde community. This Guideline outlines specific breaches of the Code of Conduct that may lead to the suspension or termination of access to the Ryde platform.

1. Maintain proper documentation to drive.
You must hold a valid national driving and vocational license at all times and other permits as may be required by the relevant authorities. You and your vehicle must also be covered with valid insurance as stipulated by local regulations. Be truthful about your criminal record. It is your responsibility to update and resubmit your documents when they expire if they are revoked or as and when requested by Ryde.

2. Cleanliness and condition of the vehicle
The driver should maintain the cleanliness of his/her vehicle so that he/she can provide his/her customers with a comfortable ride. Drivers are strictly prohibited from smoking in their vehicles. The driver should check accessories (e.g. air-con, safety belt, cashless terminal keypad) regularly to ensure that they are in proper repair or good order, and send them for repairs as soon as possible.

3. Minimum standards on proper attire
The driver should dress professionally and in a manner that is safe and comfortable for driving. As a general rule of thumb, the driver should have on a collared shirt or collared t-shirt, long pants, and covered shoes.

4. Job Acceptance & Fulfilment
Drivers should accept bookings only when they are reasonably able to complete the trip. Refusing or cancelling a trip without a valid reason at pick-up may result in account action. For bookings with specific requirements, accept only if you can fulfil them:

- RydePet: only if comfortable transporting pets (including no allergy concerns)
- Child/Booster seat: only if a suitable booster seat is available

5. Assault, harassment, or abuse of any kind will not be tolerated.
We have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of misconduct or inappropriate behavior between drivers and passengers. This includes, but is not limited to:

- Attempted or Actual Physical Assault
- Verbal or Physical Sexual Harassment
- Rape
- Murder
- Kidnapping
- Threats and Intimidation
- Unwanted Sexual Advances

These behaviors are strictly prohibited, whether consensual or otherwise. Additionally, drivers must not ask overly personal questions, comment on anyone's appearance, or contact passengers after a trip for personal reasons. In any dispute, drivers must not take matters into their own hands but follow the appropriate reporting procedures.

Violations of these guidelines will result in immediate termination and legal action where applicable.

6. Do not commit crimes.
You may be penalized under the prevailing law if you commit any criminal acts such as theft, robbery, possession of illicit materials or weapons, acts of vandalism or damage to property. We will work closely with law enforcement agencies to investigate and prosecute offenders.

7. Follow Road Safety Laws
Drivers must strictly observe all road safety laws and drive responsibly at all times. Reckless or dangerous driving that endangers passengers, pedestrians, or other road users is strictly prohibited. This includes:

- Complying with all regulatory and traffic laws
- Adhering to speed limits and obeying road signals and traffic lights
- Avoiding the use of mobile phones, laptops, or any digital devices while driving
- Using only hands-free kits when necessary
- Ensuring that all passengers wear seatbelts at all times
- Wearing your own seatbelt at all times

Operating a vehicle while distracted is a serious safety hazard. Avoid driving for extended hours without rest, and take regular breaks to maintain alertness and ensure safety on the road.

8. Alcohol, drugs, and weapons are not tolerated.
Do not consume drugs or alcohol while you are on the Ryde platform. Illegal substances, open containers of alcohol, and weapons are not permitted in your vehicle. If a user or member of the public believes you may be under the influence of drugs or alcohol, they have the right to end the booking immediately and alert Ryde or the authorities. Do not accept or deliver illegal items and/or dangerous goods, including any special requests from users for goods and/or services that are not part of Ryde's services. If you have reason to suspect the nature of the contents of your parcel, please notify Ryde and the authorities.

9. Practice good hygiene.
Maintain good personal hygiene at all times. Please help ensure a safe environment for your customers, your family, and yourself.

10. Visual display unit
Do not have iPads on your dashboards (where such visual display can be a distraction) is not allowed under rule 126 of the Road Traffic (Motor Vehicles, Construction and Use) Rules. In this rule - "ERP facility" and "in-vehicle unit" have the same meanings as in the Road Traffic (Electronic Road Pricing System) Rules (R 38); "visual display unit" means any appliance or electronic system that displays information in the form of images or words on a screen.

articles.title: I was involved in an accident. What should I do?
articles.body_text:
If you were in an accident, stop the vehicle and move to a safe area away from traffic.

Here are four steps to follow.

STOP your vehicle at the scene
- Keep calm and do not lose your temper
- Try not to move your vehicle before capturing evidence

CHECK for danger or injury
- Call 995 if anyone is seriously injured or in need of medical attention
- Do not move the injured or vehicles unnecessarily while waiting for help

GATHER information
- Take pictures of the damaged and surrounding areas
- Note the place and time of the accident
- Exchange Particulars of Parties Involved in the Accident and take note of the vehicle numbers
- Full name
- NRIC
- Address
- Contact number
- Car registration number
- Name of insurance company

REPORT the accident (recommended within 2 hours)

If your car is unsafe to drive, please call your authorised car workshop
- Call Your Insurer's Hotline for a Tow-Truck or further advice on the accident
- Your passengers may file a medical claim through you, even if you are not at fault
- Make a traffic accident report within 24 hours when an accident involves injury, death, pedestrian, cyclist, government or foreign vehicles and government property.
- Report to your Insurance company for claims and coverage.
- Report to us swiftly via RydeHelp within 1 hour.

*Applies for all bookings.

articles.title: Multi Select Trips
articles.body_text:
1. What is Multi-Select?

Multi-Select allows you to select more than one eligible ride option when making a booking.

By selecting multiple ride options, your booking can be considered across a wider pool of available drivers, giving you more matching opportunities through a single request.

You will still receive one confirmed ride with one driver.

2. Will I be charged for selecting multiple ride options?

No. There is no additional fee for using Multi-Select.

You will only be charged for the ride option you are matched with, based on the applicable fare shown for that ride.

Selecting multiple options does not mean you will be charged for multiple rides.

3. How will I know which ride type I was matched with?

You'll be matched with one of the ride types you selected, depending on which eligible driver accepts your booking first.

For example, if you select RydeFLASH and RydeX, you may be matched with either RydeFLASH or RydeX. You will not be matched with a ride type you did not select.

Once a driver accepts your booking, the assigned ride type and applicable fare will be shown in your booking details.

4. Will I receive more than one driver if I select multiple ride options?

No. Although your request may be considered across multiple eligible ride options, only one driver will be assigned to your booking.

5. Can I change my selected ride options after booking?

No. Once your booking has been confirmed, the selected ride options cannot be changed.

If you need a different ride option, you may need to cancel the existing booking and make a new booking, subject to the applicable cancellation policy.

Multi-Select is not available for Advance Bookings.

6. Can I use Multi-Select for Advance Booking?

At the moment, Multi-Select is only available for on-demand bookings. If you'd like to schedule a ride in advance, you can continue to use Advance Booking for a specific ride option of your choice.

7. Can I use Multi-Select for private booking?

No. Multi-Select is not available for private bookings.

A private booking assigns your job specifically to the driver you requested, so the booking is only offered to that particular driver.

8. What happens if no driver accepts my Multi-Select booking?

Your booking will continue to follow the applicable booking and matching process.

If the booking remains unmatched or expires, you can make another booking based on the options available at that time.

9. What if I only want a specific ride option?

If you only want a specific ride option, you can select that option instead of using Multi-Select. Under the current Multi-Select design, RydeFLASH works as a combined matching option with RydeX.

When you select RydeFLASH, your booking request is considered across both RydeFLASH and RydeX, giving you more matching opportunities through a single request.

You will still receive only one confirmed ride, and the applicable ride type and fare will be clearly shown in the app.

Multi-Select allows a rider to select more than one eligible ride option in a single booking.

The booking may then be made available to eligible drivers across the selected ride services, creating more opportunities for drivers to receive jobs.

Only one driver will ultimately be assigned to the booking.

2. Which drivers are eligible to receive Multi-Select bookings?

Eligibility depends on the service selected and the driver's:

- Driver type
- Vehicle capacity
- Applicable service eligibility

Only drivers who meet the requirements for the relevant service will be able to receive the booking.

3. How will Multi-Select bookings appear in the Driver App?

A Multi-Select booking will appear as an eligible job in the Driver App.

Where a driver is eligible for more than one selected service, the system will display one job card for the booking rather than multiple job cards for the same trip.

4. Which fare will I receive?

The fare shown on the job card is the applicable fare for the service presented to you.

If you accept the booking, the applicable fare shown for that job will apply to your trip, subject to the usual fare rules and any applicable adjustments.

5. Why did the booking disappear after I tried to accept it?

A Multi-Select booking may no longer be available if another eligible driver has already accepted it or if the booking has expired.

The booking may briefly remain visible until the Driver App refreshes.

If you attempt to accept a booking that has already been taken, you may see a "Job Taken" message.

6. Will Multi-Select affect my rating?

Multi-Select bookings will be subject to the applicable driver metrics. Multi-Select itself does not change how these metrics are calculated.

7. Can I tell which other ride options the rider selected?

No. The Driver App will show the applicable service and fare for the job presented to you. Other ride options selected by the rider will not be shown as separate job options.

articles.title: Pickup Distance Upgraded
articles.body_text:
You spoke, we listened.

We've updated how distances are shown so you can make faster, clearer and more confident decisions before accepting a job.

1. What does "actual route distance" mean?

You now see the real driving distance you'll take, no surprises, no hidden detours.

Instead of a straight-line distance, the app now follows actual road routes from your location to the pickup and drop-off points.

2. Why was this change made?

To help you avoid unexpected long pickups and make your trips more predictable and fair.

By showing the actual route, you can better judge if a job is worth your time before committing.

3. Will this affect my earnings?

No. Fares are calculated from actual driven distance and time, so you are always paid correctly for the route you take. This change only improves visibility before you accept a job.

4. Why do some jobs still display straight-line distance?

During peak load or brief system congestion, the app may temporarily show straight-line distance. This doesn't affect your earnings or acceptance; you can still choose the jobs you're comfortable with.

5. Why does it sometimes differ from Google Maps or Waze?

Small variations are normal but your Ryde distance remains accurate for the job.

Different apps may show slightly different distances because each platform uses its own map data and routing logic.

6. Why do some pickup distances appear much farther now?

You're seeing the actual distance, so you can decide with full clarity.

Actual route distance includes one-way roads, turns, and expressway entries that straight-line calculations never showed before. What you see now reflects what you'll really drive.

7. Will I still receive jobs that are far away?

Yes, Allocation still uses straight-line distance for now, so some jobs may appear further on the new calculation. You can freely accept or decline, no penalties. We're improving this gradually so job lists become even more accurate over time.

8. What about traffic or road closures?

Your route updates automatically, helping you stay efficient.

The system recalculates in real time to keep your distance and ETA as accurate as possible.

9. What if I notice discrepancies?

We want your feedback; it helps us refine the system.

GPS or map glitches may happen occasionally. Simply report it to support via Rydehelp so we can improve accuracy.

10. Why is this update important?

Because it gives you clearer information, better control, and more accurate job decisions while protecting your efficiency and earnings.

articles.title: I lost my item.
articles.body_text:
We are sorry to hear that you have lost your item and understand you may be distressed about this. We take this matter seriously and will do our best to help you locate your item.

Trip ended less than 24 hours ago

We all know that the fastest way to find or retrieve a lost item is to contact the driver directly.

1. Tap on Trips > Past, and select the trip in which you left your item.
2. Tap on 'I lost an item.'
3. Tap on the Contact Driver button to call or chat with your driver.
4. The chat log will be available in the side menu.

The chat log & call driver option will only be available up to 24 hours from the time the trip ends.

Please make all necessary arrangements and exchange details before the chat log is erased.

Trip ended more than 24 hours ago

2. Tap on 'I lost an item.'
3. Provide the necessary details for us to best assist you.

If an Item is Found

1. With the driver's consent, we will provide you with their contact number.
2. Arrange with the driver privately for the return of the item in good time. We recommend 24 hours as a guideline as drivers may not be available immediately.
3. We recommend that you compensate the driver for the trip, based on the distance from his/her location to yours (based on RydeX fares).
(We recommend a $25 minimum fare to compensate for the driver's time.)

If the Item is NOT Found

1. The driver will make an official declaration to Ryde that he/she made best efforts to find the item but was unable to do so.
2. Ryde will inform you in the event of this, after which you are advised to make a police report if the item is valuable.

A unique trip refers to a trip picking up a new rider. To be calculated and included in the bonus count, the "unique trip" must be from a different rider's request. If you have picked up the rider before, the trip will not be considered a unique trip.

How can I capture unique trips?
In order to capture unique trips, drivers must review and complete the unique trip. Additionally, all riders should leave a review to help identify the unique trip. This means that if you have picked up a rider before, the trip will not be considered a unique trip.

What happens if there are criteria that are not met?
The bonus tracks will be paused should there be any criteria that are not met. All the criteria must be in GREEN in order for trips to be counted. In case one of the criteria, such as a high cancellation rate, is not met, you will see it in RED instead of GREEN. Your bonus tracking will be paused at that point in time until all the criteria have been met.

Where can I check the conditions for the incentives?
You may check the conditions for the incentives in your app. Please note that only unique trips will be counted for the bonuses.

articles.title: RydePOOL Auto switch
articles.body_text:
1. Why was my RydePOOL ride switched to RydeX?
If we can't find a RydePOOL match after 90 seconds, we'll automatically switch your booking to a RydeX. This helps increase the likelihood of finding you a driver sooner, so you can get on your way faster.

There's no need to cancel or make a new booking. We'll handle the switch automatically and continue searching for a driver while keeping your booking details the same.

2. Will I be notified before the switch and when my booking is switched?
Yes. Before you confirm your booking, we'll show you the reserved RydeX fare and the time window during which your booking will automatically switch if no RydePOOL match is found.

While we're searching for a driver, you'll also see the switching time in the app. If your booking is switched to RydeX, we'll notify you via a push notification.

Your pickup location, destination, and all other booking details will remain unchanged.

3. Will the fare change?
Yes, the fare may change. RydePOOL and RydeX are different ride services with different fares.
When you book a RydePOOL ride, we'll also show you a reserved RydeX fare upfront. This fare will only apply if your booking is automatically switched to RydeX.

If your booking remains as a RydePOOL ride, you'll pay the RydePOOL fare. If it's switched to RydeX, you'll pay the pre-reserved RydeX fare shown at the time of booking.
The final fare will be reflected in the app, and you'll only be charged based on the service type of your completed trip.

4. Can I choose not to switch to RydeX?
Auto-switch is designed to help you get matched with a driver sooner, so RydePOOL bookings will automatically switch to RydeX if no match is found within the waiting period.

If you no longer wish to continue with the booking after it has switched, you may cancel before a driver is matched. Please note that the standard cancellation policy may apply.

5. My payment method has enough balance for RydePOOL, why can't I book it?
Because your booking may be automatically switched to RydeX, your selected payment method must have sufficient funds or available credit to cover the reserved RydeX fare to ensure a smooth booking experience.

6. Why is a higher amount temporarily held on my payment method?
When you book a RydePOOL ride, we may temporarily authorise or hold the reserved RydeX fare on your payment method.
This is not an additional charge. It's a temporary authorisation that allows your booking to switch seamlessly to RydeX if no RydePOOL match is found.

If your trip is completed as a RydePOOL ride, you'll only be charged the RydePOOL fare. Any unused authorised amount will be released by your bank or payment provider according to their processing timeline.

7. Does auto-switch affect how I pay for my trip?
No. Your selected payment method will remain the same.

You'll only be charged the final fare for the service you completed. If a higher amount was temporarily authorised, any unused amount will be released or refunded by your bank or payment provider.

Ryde Carpool operates under the Road Traffic (Car Pools) (Exemption) Order 2021 and the LTA Point-to-Point (P2P) regulatory framework, which regulate carpooling in Singapore as a not-for-profit activity. This means that carpool drivers may recover reasonable costs such as fuel, tolls, and vehicle maintenance, but are not permitted to make a profit from these trips.

To support the sustainability of the carpool ecosystem, a portion of the total fare is retained by Ryde to cover:

- Technology infrastructure and platform maintenance
- Customer support services
- Safety and trust systems
- Incentives and bonuses
- Regulatory compliance efforts

These deductions enable Ryde to continue operating a safe, reliable, and compliant carpooling platform for both drivers and riders.

Note: Carpool drivers are limited to two paid trips per day, in accordance with LTA regulations.

Drivers seeking more flexibility and earnings potential may consider becoming PDVL Driver which allows for additional trip types and fare opportunities outside the carpool regulations.

articles.body_text:
How to top up your RydeCoins

1. Tap on the Wallet on the top right corner.
2. Choose Top-Up.
3. Choose your value and top-up method.
4. Tap Top-Up when completed.
5. Your available coins will be displayed. You can now choose to pay with RydeCoins!

Can I refund my RydeCoins?

Like a prepaid mobile plan, RydeCoins are non-refundable and not redeemable, exchanged or transferred for cash value under any circumstances.

Will my RydeCoins expire?

Your coins are valid for 6 months from your last wallet transaction.

How much RydeCoins can I top up each time?

There is a top up limit of $1,000 per transaction.

What is the minimum amount I can top-up in my RydeCoins wallet?

The minimum amount needed for a top-up is $2.

What is the maximum amount I can have in my RydeCoins wallet?

Your RydeCoins wallet should hold a maximum of $1,000 at any one time.

Can RydeCoins be combined with other payment methods for any rides?

No. Payment has to be made in full using RydeCoins.

What does "On-Hold" mean in my transaction history?

Your Rydecoins are held for an upcoming ride and will be deducted after a trip is completed. No coins will be deducted if the ride is cancelled.

Can I use RydeCoins overseas?

No, your RydeCoins will only be valid locally.

If you find a lost item in your vehicle and know which trip it is from (Known Trip):

- Item Description
- Trip ID/Details
- Location of the item found in the vehicle
- Consent to share your mobile number with the rider for contact purposes

If you are unsure which trip the lost item is from (Unknown Trip):

1. Step 1: Verify that the lost item is from a Ryde trip
2. Step 2: Make a police report immediately
3. Step 3: Submit a copy of the police report via RydeHELP
4. Step 4: Ryde will follow up with the rider based on the police report

In the event that you find an item after 24 hours from trip completion, we encourage you to grant our team consent to share your mobile number with the rider. After which, the rider will be in touch with you to make arrangements on returning the item. We encourage you to do this as soon as possible.

We also recommend that any compensation collected from the rider reflects the distance you travelled to reach them, with a minimum fare of $25 to account for your time and effort.

In the event any Platform content contains any typographical errors, inaccuracies, omissions or otherwise violates Ryde Policies, we reserve the right to (but shall not be obliged to, save to the extent where mandated by applicable laws) carry out any such measures as Ryde deems appropriate (collectively, "Rectification Measure") including without limitation (i) correcting the said errors, inaccuracies or omissions, (ii) changing or updating information; and/or (iii) where applicable, canceling the affected orders at any time without prior notice (including without limitation after an order has been submitted).

clauses.topic: RydeCoins (refund destination) are non-refundable and not convertible to cash
clauses.text: RydeCoins are solely intended for use within our Platform and are non-refundable, and cannot be redeemed, exchanged, transferred or converted into cash or utilized for any transactions outside of our services.

clauses.topic: RydeCoins validity six months from last transaction
clauses.text: The RydeCoins will only be valid for six (6) months from the date of the last transaction.

clauses.topic: RydeCoins not redeemable for cash nor refundable
clauses.text: The RydeCoins are not redeemable for cash nor refundable under any circumstances.

clauses.topic: RydeCoins non-refundable including on account closure
clauses.text: For the avoidance of doubt, RydeCoins are non-refundable and not redeemable, exchanged or transferred for cash value under any circumstances - including the closing down of one's own user account.
